event: Two chilled-water coils in Engineering Centers Building froze in parallel air-handling systems; top floor flooded; plant staff detected loss of chilled water
notes: Daily Cardinal: "A mechanical flaw caused a 30,000-gallon spill ... Friday morning." Separate statement elsewhere of ~55,000 gallons is from a search snippet and conflicts; not used. Cause: coils froze, alarms did not sound.

event: Leak found in 48-inch chilled water main from Charter Street plant; central AC shut to 33 campus buildings for at least a week
numbers: 48-inch main; 33 buildings; water losses rose from normal 9,000 gal/day to 100,000 gal/day; 16-ft section ~8 ft underground
notes: Page is access-restricted; facts come only from a search-result summary. Do not treat as verified. Steam-tunnel detail not confirmed.

event: Engineering Centers flood tied to 2019 cold snap
notes: No source found in searches. Do not use until a source is located. The Dec 2005 Engineering Centers flood is the only documented Engineering Centers water event found.

event: Associate VC for FP&M Cindy Torstveit tells Regents UW-Madison faces "a tsunami of building issues"; says ~$2.5B deferred maintenance (quote reported July 2026)
notes: Cap Times says Torstveit "previously told the Regents in February"; exact Regents date not confirmed. Total excludes underground utilities per UW spokesperson Lori Wilson.

event: Board of Regents Capital Planning and Budget Committee approves ~$3M to repair chilled water system in Engineering Centers Building
notes: WMTV dates approval June 4 but also says approval came "26 days before UW-Madison AC issues" (which would be ~May 22). Conflict unresolved; June 4 used.

event: Charmany Farms Veterinary Medicine Building: ~$3M approved to replace failing chiller system; chiller replaced by rented chiller on temporary piping and hoses
notes: This is the "Charmany chiller" item. Article does not say whether replacement construction has started.

event: Major chilled water main supply line ruptures near Charter Street plant (one of three heating/cooling plants); campus cooling reduced
numbers: pipe 4 ft diameter, ~20 ft underground; repairs took nearly two months
notes: FAQ: "On June 17, a chilled water main supply line at one of the three heating and cooling plants..."

event: UW posts first campus cooling update: repairs expected at least several weeks; reduced cooling begins
UW update: temperature adjustments begin; closures announced; repair "expected to take at least one month"
notes: Raw: raw/articles/news_wisc_update439.txt. Channel 3000 cites a Sunday morning statement by Robert Cramer.

event: 34 buildings listed; 23 closed to the public and locked end of business day; 11 partially closed. Employees relocated.
numbers: 34 buildings (23 closed + 11 partial); ~30 temporary chillers installed
notes: Building-level list in curated/affected_buildings_2026.csv. Channel 3000 article date not shown in saved HTML; 23/11 split also in WMTV.

event: Badger Herald: "over 20 buildings" to be temporarily closed; some open with limited cooling
UW system official Deej Lundgren tells Regents damaged pipe section removed; permanent replacement underway; cost still being calculated; Engineering Drive utility project to support repair
notes: Cap Times article on Regents virtual meeting July 16.

event: All closed and partially closed buildings fully reopened; mail, packages, parking normal
numbers: 34 buildings reopened (per FAQ "all closed and partially closed")
notes: FAQ updated Aug 9; mobile chilling units remain into September.

event: UW discloses total cost of cooling problems ($15.8M); Regents vote to reallocate $40M to related Engineering Drive utilities project
notes: Cap Times: "On Oct. 8, the University of Wisconsin-Madison revealed..."
